# SCI-POINT ODQ-003 Scientific-Owner Approval

Record identity: `SCI-POINT-ODQ-003-APPROVAL-2026-09-02`

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Decision date: `2026-09-02`

Status: approved Stage A scientific direction

## Approved Decision

SCI-POINT v0.1 may admit each of these observation-local per-array parent
families as a distinct explicit POINT method route:

- ordinary MAP;
- JINC;
- FLT-FIXED; and
- FLT-MATCHED.

POINT is route-parameterized but never route-agnostic. Every requested route
must bind its exact parent product, method, version, generation, estimand,
unit, WCS/frame/grid, support/validity, response, covariance/uncertainty,
calibration, and provenance meanings. POINT may not select, substitute,
equate, or fall back among these families automatically.

When an admitted terminal product was created through FRUIT, it enters POINT
under its exact terminal MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, or FLT-MATCHED type and retains
complete FRUIT method, terminal-iteration, generation, response, support,
uncertainty, and lineage ancestry. FRUIT is not a fifth POINT parent family.

Coadd products and intermediate FRUIT iterations remain outside base v0.1.

## Availability Boundary

This decision establishes scientific family eligibility. It does not by
itself establish that any numerical route is currently available or correctly
bound. Each route remains unavailable until its exact predecessor authority,
numerical product, required state, and POINT compatibility boundary are
present and bound. Unavailability of one eligible route does not authorize
fallback to another.

## Non-Effects

This approval does not answer ODQ-004 through ODQ-009, approve the complete
Stage A packet, authorize Stage B, edit a predecessor contract, change an
algorithm, or establish implementation conformity, validation, achieved
performance, readiness, or production state.

The earlier FRUIT-lineage and coadd decisions remain preserved in
`SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_ODQ_003A_003B_DIRECTION_2026-09-02.md`.
